metadata.question: In the summer of 2021, did at least 6 million hectares of forests burn in Sakha?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about forest fires in Sakha (Yakutia) during summer 2021, specifically whether at least 6 million hectares burned. For this analysis, I need to: 1. Use burned area data - MODIS burned area product (MCD64A1) would be appropriate 2. Define Sakha region geometry 3. Filter for summer 2021 (June-August) 4. Calculate total burned area in hectares 5. Compare against 6 million hectares threshold Data strategy: - Use MCD64A1.006 MODIS Burned Area Monthly Global 500m - BurnDate band shows when pixels burned - Summer 2021 = June-August 2021 Processing: - Sum burned pixels across the summer months - Convert pixel count to area (each 500m pixel = 25 hectares) - Check if total >= 6,000,000 hectares Validation: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if no burned pixels found (C2) - Validate area calculation (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Sakha (Yakutia) geometry - using approximate bounding box const sakha = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([105, 55, 165, 75]); // 2. Summer 2021 date range (June-August) const startDate = '2021-06-01'; const endDate = '2021-08-31'; // 3. Load MODIS burned area data const burnedCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sakha); const colSize = burnedCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Summer 2021 burned area images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Create burned area mask (BurnDate > 0 indicates burned) const burnedSummer = burnedCol.map(img => img.select('BurnDate').gt(0)); const totalBurned = burnedSummer.sum(); // 5. Calculate area - each 500m pixel = 0.25 km² = 25 hectares const areaImg = totalBurned.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(10000); // Convert to hectares // 6. Calculate total burned area in Sakha const stats = areaImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e13 }); const burnedAreaHa = stats.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const burnedPixels = totalBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e13 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`Burned area (hectares): ${burnedAreaHa?.toFixed(0) || 'No data'}`); console.log(`Burned pixels: ${burnedPixels?.toFixed(0) || 'No data'}`); // 7. Validation and answer if (burnedAreaHa === null || burnedAreaHa === undefined || isNaN(burnedAreaHa)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (burnedPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (burnedAreaHa >= 6000000) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
